description: Real-time indoor environment monitoring – 2 modules (SCD41+BH1750 / BME688+BH1750).

targets.query:
bucket_hot = from(bucket: "iot-hot")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "iot_sensors")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with source: "hot" }))

bucket_archives = from(bucket: "iot-archives")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "iot_sensors")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with source: "archives" }))

union(tables: [bucket_hot, bucket_archives])

import "experimental"

base =
  from(bucket: "iot-hot")
    |> range(start: -7d)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "iot_sensors")
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
        r["_field"] == "temperature" or
        r["_field"] == "humidity"    or
        r["_field"] == "co2"         or
        r["_field"] == "lux"         or
        r["_field"] == "iaq"         or
        r["_field"] == "pressure"    or
        r["_field"] == "rssi"
    )
    |> group(columns: ["device_id", "_field"])
    |> last()

// Table 1 — données pivotées (sans seconds_ago)
pivoted =
  base
    |> group()
    |> pivot(rowKey: ["device_id", "hw_model"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
    |> keep(columns: [
        "device_id", "hw_model", "active_sensors",
        "temperature", "humidity", "co2", "lux", "iaq", "pressure", "rssi"
    ])

// Table 2 — seconds_ago calculé sur le champ temperature uniquement (1 _time fiable par device)
last_seen =
  base
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "temperature")
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        device_id: r.device_id,
        seconds_ago: float(v: int(v: now()) - int(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0
    }))
    |> group()
    |> keep(columns: ["device_id", "seconds_ago"])

join(tables: {p: pivoted, l: last_seen}, on: ["device_id"])

panels.title: IAQ Score (BME688) – Indoor Air Quality Index

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.location == "${room}")
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_measurement", "_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "scd41_temperature", "scd41_humidity", "scd41_co2", "bme688_temperature", "bme688_humidity", "bme688_pressure", "bme688_iaq", "bh1750_lux"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.location == "${room}" and (r._field == "temperature" or r._field == "humidity"))
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with 
      comfort: if r.temperature < 20 then 95 
               else if r.temperature < 22 then 85 
               else if r.temperature < 26 then 70 
               else 40
  }))
  |> keep(columns: ["comfort"])
  |> last()
